preconditions.description: The number of objects in the ski resort is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each object is either a mountain (0) or a hotel (1).

preconditions.expression: at least one object is a hotel
preconditions.description: There is at least one hotel in the resort.
The ski track information for each object is between 0 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The path length is at least 1.
The last object in the path is a hotel.
All objects before the last in the path are mountains.

postconditions.expression: all(a_v_i == v_i+1 for i in range(k-1))
postconditions.description: For each pair of consecutive objects in the path, there is a ski track from the first to the second.
The path length is the maximum possible given the constraints.
